method: Scoped H2/H4/H6/H8 expert review of brand delta against existing H1-H10 design plan. Other behavior retains prior evidence, not a new full heuristic-suite execution.

coverage.actual_observation: Exact owner-requested name is readable on navigation and sign-in.
Brand control retains Discussion destination and accessible full name; mobile navigation still closes after destination selection.
Warm yellow retains written Head Consultant name and HC initials; logo never substitutes for navigation labels.
Compact original SVG and two-line wordmark fit 320px; logo has no animation, external assets or added settings.

limitations: Brand and colour design revision only; no production authentication, AI, research, recording, storage or deployment.

54 responsive observations cover sign-in, discussion and Settings at six widths across three candidates. The full 44-state sequence and interaction suite were not rerun for this presentation-only delta.
No representative-user, VoiceOver, physical keyboard, forced-colors or full WCAG/security/performance validation.
Screenshots were inspected inline using CUA; no exported raster capture is claimed.
